claim.quote: The measurement accurately constrains the density dependence of the symmetry energy of nuclear matter near saturation density, with implications for the size and composition of neutron stars.

key_value_text.quote: Combined with our previous measurement, the extracted neutron skin thickness is $R_n-R_p=0.283 \pm 0.071$~fm.

name: PREX-II: accurate determination of the neutron skin thickness of 208Pb

summary.plain: PREX-II repeated the lead-208 measurement with much better precision. Combined with the first run it gives a neutron skin of 0.283 ± 0.071 femtometres, constraining the stiffness of nuclear matter and thus neutron-star properties.
summary.technical: A_PV = 550 ± 16 (stat) ± 8 (syst) ppb for elastic scattering of longitudinally polarised electrons from 208Pb, giving the neutral weak form factor F_W(Q^2 = 0.00616 GeV^2) = 0.368 ± 0.013 and, with PREX-I, R_n - R_p = 0.283 ± 0.071 fm; also the first significant direct measurement of the interior weak density of 208Pb.

title: Accurate Determination of the Neutron Skin Thickness of $^{208}$Pb through Parity-Violation in Electron Scattering
why_it_matters: Constrains the density dependence of the symmetry energy near saturation density, with implications for the size and composition of neutron stars.
